data.one_liner: Provides a widget that requires a double back press to exit the app on Android.
data.what_it_does: Wraps your UI in a widget that intercepts the Android back button. On first press it shows a SnackBar; a second press within a short interval closes the app. Handles SnackBar dismissal correctly.
use_when: You want a simple double‑back‑to‑exit behavior on Android
You need a lightweight solution without native code
avoid_when: You need custom back‑navigation logic or iOS‑specific behavior
You require more advanced exit handling or multiple back‑press actions
strengths: Very small and easy to integrate
weaknesses: Limited customization of timing and UI
May conflict with other back‑button handlers
